name: self-live
description: Compartilhamento de tela e áudio P2P para Windows
author: Self Live

scripts.test:relay: node --test relay/test/relay.test.js test/relay-client.test.js test/relay-preload.test.js && node scripts/run-relay-smoke.js && node scripts/run-relay-smoke.js --forced
scripts.test:upnp: node --test test/portmapper.test.js test/network.test.js test/access-link.test.js test/signaling-client.test.js test/media-ports.test.js test/connectivity.test.js test/shutdown.test.js && node scripts/run-upnp-check.js
scripts.test:capture-state: npm run build:capture-state && node --test test/capture-state.test.js test/capture-lifecycle.test.js && node scripts/run-capture-state-smoke.js
scripts.test:gpu-priority: npm run build:gpu-priority && node --test test/gpu-priority.test.js && node scripts/run-gpu-priority-smoke.js
scripts.predist:pilot: npm run build:audio && npm run build:gpu-priority && npm run build:capture-state
scripts.predist: npm run build:audio && npm run build:gpu-priority && npm run build:capture-state
scripts.test:native-mvp: node --test test/native-mvp.test.js test/native-internet.test.js test/native-direct.test.js test/native-network.test.js && node scripts/run-native-mvp-smoke.js
scripts.test:native-automatic: node --test test/native-direct.test.js test/native-network.test.js && node scripts/run-native-automatic-ui-smoke.js && node scripts/run-native-receiver-diagnostics-smoke.js && node scripts/run-native-internet-smoke.js --direct
scripts.dist:native-mvp: npm run build:native-mvp && node scripts/stage-native-mvp.js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.native-mvp.yml --win portable --x64
